blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision language navigation (VLN) is very challenging for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) since small errors in 3D motion prediction can lead to navigation errors and collisions. Unable to fathom execution outcomes in 3D environments, existing methods often struggle to predict accurate navigation waypoints from language instructions. To solve this, we introduce the Prototypical Visual Imagination framework, shortened as ProtoVis-Nav, which forces the model to imagine an outcome-associated local visual representation for the intended next UAV movement. Specifically, we predict feature prototypes and use their linear combination to estimate the visual feature of the target region. In this manner, the VLN model first imagines the local visual representation of the next intended location, and then uses predicted prototypes as context for generating the final action, promoting alignment between visual context and waypoint outputs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the ProtoVis-Nav framework and show substantial improvements over existing baselines.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言导航(VLN)对于无人驾驶飞行器(UAVs)来说是非常具有挑战性的,因为3D运动预测中的小错误会导致导航错误和碰撞. 无法在3D环境中fathom执行结果,现有方法往往难以从语言指令中预测准确的导航路标. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了原型视觉想象框架,缩短为ProtoVis-Nav,这个框架迫使模型想象出一个与预期的下一个无人机运动相关的本地视觉表现. 具体来说,我们预测特征原型,并使用它们的线性组合来估计目标区域的视觉特征. 这样,VLN模型首先想象下一个预定位置的当地视觉表现,然后使用预测的原型作为产生最终行动的上下文,促进视觉上下文与路标输出的一致. 广泛的实验表明ProtoVis-Nav框架的有效性,并显示比现有基线有重大改进。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) is a challenging problem in embodied AI, enabling agents to navigate complex environments while following natural language instructions Gu et al. (2022) ; Park and Kim (2023) . Although early VLN research predominantly centered on indoor navigation for ground-based robots Krantz et al. (2020) ; Ku et al. (2020) ; Zhou et al. (2024) ; Huang et al. (2023) , a growing body of recent work focuses on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) Cai et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2023) ; Wu et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2025d) ; Xiao et al. (2025) ,
where navigation involves a more challenging 3D action space and requires precise motion control and reliable 3D trajectory planning Wang et al. (2024a) .
Despite the rapid progress of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) Bai et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025a) ; Hong et al. (2025) ; Team et al. (2026) , applying them to UAV navigation remains difficult as they struggle to navigate 3D environments accurately and safely Wang et al. (2025b) ; Xiao et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh:
Vision-Language Navigation(VLN)是包含的AI中一个具有挑战性的问题,它使代理在遵循自然语言指令Gu等(2022年);Park和Kim(2023年)的同时能够导航复杂的环境. 虽然早期的VLN研究主要集中于地基机器人克兰茨等(2020年);克等(2020年);克等(2024年);克等(2023年);克等(2023年);克等(2023年)的室内导航,但最近越来越多的作品都以无人驾驶飞行器为重点. 蔡等 (2025年); 刘等 (2023年); 吴等 (2025年). 张等 (2025d). 萧等 (2025),.
导航涉及一个更具挑战性的3D行动空间,需要精确的运动控制和可靠的3D轨迹规划Wang等 (2024a).
尽管视觉语言模型(VLMs)取得了迅速的进展. Bai等人(2025);Wang等人(2025a); Hong等 (2025); Team等 (2026), 应用到无人机导航上仍然困难重重,因为他们努力准确安全地导航3D环境; Wang等 (2025b); Xiao等 (2025).

blocks.en:
A major reason for these navigation errors is the inability to associate motion predictions with their potential outcomes Nie et al. (2025) .
In fact, most methods directly predict continuous waypoints from visual observations and language instructions Arafat et al. (2023) .
Since their training objective penalizes only the waypoint error, the model can hardly anticipate the execution outcomes of its own actions Koh et al. (2021) , increasing the risk of generating trajectories that are potentially unsafe in the 3D environment.
blocks.zh:
这些导航出错的一个主要原因是无法将运动预测与其潜在结果相联(2025年)。
事实上,大多数方法直接预测了从视觉观察和语言指示阿拉法特等人(2023年)中得出的连续行进点.
由于他们的训练目标只会惩罚路口出错,该模型几乎无法预料自身行动(Koh et al. (2021))的执行结果,增加了在3D环境中产生可能不安全的轨迹的风险.

blocks.en:
To address this problem, an emerging trend in visual language navigation is to equip the agent with future-aware visual predictive capabilities, often framed as navigation world models Bar et al. (2025) .
Specifically, they usually predict the future observation via a specific video generation model Koh et al. (2021) ; Bar et al. (2025) or as outputs of the same VLN model Yao et al. (2025) ; Huang et al. (2026) ; Wang et al. (2026) . UAV navigation requires accurate fine-grained motion control grounded in local visual evidence Ding et al. (2026) . In fact, precise flight actions are often determined by small and localized visual regions ( e.g. , a narrow gap to fly through). This raises a key question: rather than generating the global future scene, can we enforce future-aware grounding by strictly focusing on these localized visual regions most critical to the upcoming movement?
blocks.zh:
为了解决这个问题,视觉语言导航方面正在出现的一种趋势是使代理机具备未来认知的视觉预测能力,这种能力往往被设定为导航世界模型Bar等 (2025).
具体来说,他们通常通过特定的视频生成模型Koh等(2021);Bar等(2025)或作为同名的VLN模型姚等(2025);Huang等(2026);Wang等(2026)的输出预测未来观测. UAV导航需要精确的细纹运动控制,基于本地视觉证据 Ding等 (2026). 事实上,精确的飞行动作往往由小而局部的视觉区域决定(如飞行需要经过的狭小差距). 这提出了一个关键问题:我们不是要创造全球未来局面,而是要严格关注这些对即将到来的运动最为关键的局部视觉区域,从而实现未来意识的立足点。

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose the Prototypical Visual Imagination framework for UAV navigation, dubbed as ProtoVis-Nav. The method is motivated by a simple idea: rather than modeling an entire future scene or a long-horizon latent rollout, the agent should focus on the exact regions most relevant to its precise movement by imagining an outcome-associated local visual representation.
To this end, we project the next intended UAV location onto the current image plane, crop the surrounding local region, and use its visual feature as the supervision target. Compared with using the entire future frame or the future-frame center, this projected region provides a supervision target that more directly grounds 3D motion prediction in the current image space, while avoiding the intractable imagination of future observations.
Plus, we introduce a prototype-based feature prediction method. Instead of using multi-layer perceptrons to directly estimate the target feature, this approach predicts a set of Prototypical Visual Imagination (PVI) tokens, which are then combined through a softmax-normalized mixing matrix, so that their linear combination matches the target-region feature. The predicted PVI tokens are less susceptible to overfitting and are then used as context for waypoint prediction, encouraging tighter alignment between visual context and continuous action outputs.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们提出了被誉为"Proto Vis-Nav"的"UAV导航的原生视觉想象"框架. 这种方法的动机很简单:不模拟整个未来场景或长期的潜在展开,代理人应该通过想象一种与结果相关的当地视觉表现,专注于与其精确运动最相关的具体区域。
为此,我们将下一个预定的无人驾驶飞行器位置投射到目前的图像平面上,在周边的局部区域进行裁剪,并使用其视觉特征作为监督目标. 与使用整个未来帧或未来帧中心相比,这个被预测的区域提供了一个监督目标,更直接地将3D运动预测置于当前图像空间中,同时避免未来观测的难以想象.
此外,我们采用了基于原型的特征预测方法。 这种方法不使用多层能见度来直接估计目标特征,而是预测出一组"原生"视觉想象(PVI)符号,然后通过软-正态混合矩阵进行组合,使其线性组合与目标区域特征相匹配. 预测的PVI符号不太容易被过度调整,然后被用作路由预测的背景,鼓励更紧密地调整视觉上下文和连续动作输出.

blocks.en: We experimentally verify the effectiveness of the proposed method on OpenUAV Wang et al. (2024a) and HUGE-Bench Guo et al. (2026) . Results show that ProtoVis-Nav substantially improves navigation performance over strong baselines and leads to more reliable continuous UAV navigation.
blocks.zh: 我们实验性地核实关于OpenUAV Wang等人(2024a)和HUGE-Bench Guo等人(2026)的拟议方法的有效性。 结果显示,ProtoVis-Nav在强基线上大大改进了导航性能并导致更可靠的持续无人驾驶航空器导航.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Vision language navigation for UAVs. Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) has traditionally focused on guiding ground agents through structured, near-planar indoor environments Krantz et al. (2020) ; Ku et al. (2020) ; Zhou et al. (2024) ; Huang et al. (2023) ; Zhao et al. (2022) ; An et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2025b) . Recently, the field has naturally extended to Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). UAV-based VLN requires agents to ground language instructions into complex, continuous flight dynamics, demanding a stronger understanding of 3D spatial reasoning. Several realistic and continuous UAV VLN benchmarks have recently emerged Wu et al. (2025) ; Xiao et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2024a) ; Wang et al. (2025b) , providing an essential foundation for open-world UAV VLN research. Building upon them, TravelUAV Wang et al. (2024a) directly regresses the next waypoint based on current observations and UAV kinematics. NavFoM Zhang et al. (2025a) further explores a cross-embodiment and cross-task navigation foundation model trained on large-scale navigation data, showing strong generalization across different navigation tasks and robotic platforms, including UAV navigation. To better process historical context, LongFly Jiang et al. (2025) introduces a history-aware spatiotemporal modeling strategy that transforms fragmented and redundant historical data into structured, compact, and expressive representations. To improve policy learning, OpenVLN Lin et al. (2025) formulates a reinforcement learning framework to optimize VLMs for UAV navigation tasks. It efficiently fine-tunes the VLM using rule-based policies under limited training data, and incorporates a long-horizon trajectory planner that generates precise UAV actions via value-based rewards.
blocks.zh: 无人驾驶飞行器的远景语言导航. Vision-Language Navigation(VLN)传统上通过结构化的近平面室内环境克兰茨等(2020年);克等(2020年);周等(2024年);黄等(2023年);赵等(2022年);安等(2025年); 张等 (2025b). 最近,球场自然地扩展到无人驾驶飞行器(UAVs). 基于无人机的VLN要求特工将语言指令地面化为复杂而持续的飞行动态,要求更深入地了解3D空间推理. 最近出现了几个现实和持续的无人驾驶飞行器VLN基准:吴等(2025年);萧等(2025年);王等(2024a年); Wang等 (2025b),为开放世界的UAV VLN研究提供重要基础. 在他们的基础上,旅行联盟 Wang等人(2024年a)根据目前的观测结果和无人驾驶飞行器动能学,直接退后了下个方向. 导航 Zhang等 (2025a)进一步探索了接受过大规模导航数据培训的跨浮图和跨任务导航基础模型,显示在包括无人机导航在内的不同导航任务和机器人平台之间强通化. 为了更好地处理历史背景,LongFly Jiang等(2025年)引入了历史认知的瞬间模型化战略,将零散和多余的历史数据转化为结构化,紧凑化,表现化. 为改善政策学习,OpenVLN Lin等. (2025) 制定强化学习框架来优化无人机导航任务的VLM. 它利用有限的培训数据,利用基于规则的政策,有效地对甚高频进行微调,并纳入一个长距离轨道规划器,通过基于价值的奖励产生精确的无人驾驶航空器行动。

blocks.en:
Despite these advancements, most continuous UAV VLN methods still mainly rely on current observations, historical context, or geometric priors for waypoint prediction.
Since their training objective focuses on waypoint error, the model receives limited guidance for identifying visual cues associated with the next intended location of the UAV, increasing the risk of generating trajectories that are potentially unsafe in the 3D environment.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进步,大多数连续的无人机VLN方法仍然主要依赖于当前的观测,历史背景,或几何前作来进行路口预测.
由于他们的训练目标侧重于出站点错误,该模型在识别与无人驾驶飞行器下一个预定位置相联的视觉提示方面得到了有限的指导,增加了生成3D环境中可能不安全的轨道的风险.

blocks.en: Navigation world models. An emerging trend in visual-language navigation is to equip agents with future-aware visual predictive capabilities, often framed as navigation world models. For example, Pathdreamer studies visual world modeling for indoor navigation, generating future 360 ∘ RGB, depth, and semantic observations along hypothetical trajectories with a two-stage structure-to-image generator Koh et al. (2021) . Dreamwalker further adapts this idea to VLN-CE by constructing an explicit environment graph and using a scene synthesizer to imagine future panoramic observations, which are then evaluated through mental planning with Monte Carlo Tree Search Wang et al. (2023) . HNR-VLN predicts multi-level CLIP-based semantic features for candidate future viewpoints via a hierarchical neural radiance representation, enabling more efficient path evaluation Wang et al. (2024b) . NWM scales this paradigm to video generation, where a diffusion transformer simulates future visual trajectories conditioned on actions and ranks or plans routes according to goal similarity Bar et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 导航世界模型. 视觉语言导航方面出现的一个新趋势是使代理机具备未来感知的视觉预测能力,这种能力常常被设定为导航世界模型. 例如,Pathdreamer研究室内导航的视觉世界模型,创造未来 360 QQ RGB,深度,和语义沿假想轨迹进行观测,并有两相结构对映生成器Koh等(2021). "梦行者"进一步将这个想法适应了VLN-CE,构建了清晰的环境图并使用场景合成器来想象未来的全景观测,然后通过精神规划与Monte Carlo Tree Search Wang等(2023年)进行评估. HNR-VLN通过分级神经光度代表来预测候选人未来观点的多层次CLIP基语义特征,使王等(2024b)的路径评价更有效率. NWM将这种范式缩放到视频生成中,其中扩散变压器会模拟未来以动作为条件的可视轨迹,并根据目标相近性Bar等(2025)来排列或规划路线.

blocks.en: More recent methods emphasize compact and adaptive latent prediction: UNeMo predicts the next visual state from visual features, language instructions, and candidate actions, feeding the predicted state back to refine navigation decisions Huang et al. (2026) . MonoDream uses latent panoramic dreaming to predict current and future panoramic RGB-D features from a forward-facing RGB view, thereby compensating for limited field of view without explicit panoramic sensors Wang et al. (2026) . DriveVLA-W0 uses future-image prediction to supervise driving representations Li et al. (2026) , while ANWM predicts action-conditioned future observations for UAV trajectory evaluation Zhang et al. (2025c) .
blocks.zh: 较新的方法强调紧凑而适应性强的潜在预测: UNeMo从视觉特征,语言说明,以及候选行为等预测下一个视觉状态,将预测状态反馈到完善通航决定黄等 (2026). MonoDream利用潜在的全景梦从前向的RGB视角来预测当前和未来的全景RGB-D特征,从而在没有明确全景传感器Wang等(2026)的情况下补偿有限的视野. DriveVLA-W0使用未来图像预测来监督驱动表达 Li等人(2026年),而ANWM则预测未来对无人驾驶航空器轨迹评价的有行动条件的观测. Zhang等人(2025年c).

blocks.en:
While effective for future-aware visual world models, they focus on generating global scene representations, such as full-frame videos or panoramic latents. However, UAVs require accurate fine-grained motion control, grounded in local visual evidence. Predicting the background and surroundings can provide general orientation, but precise flight actions are often determined by small and localized visual regions ( e.g. , a narrow gap to fly through).
To bridge this gap, our proposed ProtoVis-Nav framework departs from the global imagination paradigm. Instead of predicting complete future frames or global features, we explicitly project the intended future 3D location onto the current 2D image plane and predict prototypical visual tokens strictly for that local region. This localized, prototype-based imagination encourages the UAV to ground its motion decisions in the most critical visual context for more accurate and reliable continuous aerial navigation in 3D space.
blocks.zh:
虽然对未来的视觉世界模型有效,但它们侧重于生成全球场景的展示,如全帧视频或全景潜想. 然而,无人驾驶飞行器需要精确的精细分泌运动控制,以当地的视觉证据为基础. 预测背景和周围环境可以提供一般取向,但精确的飞行动作往往由小而局部的视觉区域决定(例如飞行需要经过的狭小差距).
为了弥合这一差距,我们提议的Proto Vis-Nav框架偏离了全球想象范式。 我们没有预测完整的未来框架或全球特征,而是将预期的未来3D位置明确投射到目前的2D图像平面上,并严格地预测该地段的原始视觉标志. 这种以本地化,原型为基础的想象力鼓励了无人机在最关键的视觉背景下进行运动决定,以便在3D空间进行更准确和更可靠的连续空中导航.

blocks.en: Regarding local visual supervision, our method differs from ReconVLA Song et al. (2026) , which reconstructs gaze regions around the objects to be manipulated in the current image with a diffusion model to guide visual attention. ProtoVis-Nav constructs its local target by projecting the next intended 3D UAV location onto the current 2D image plane, linking local visual supervision to the intended execution outcome of the next action.
blocks.zh: 关于局部视觉监督,我们的方法不同于ReconVLA Song et al. (2026年),它用一种传播模型来引导视觉注意力,将周围的物体重新凝视。 原型 Vis-Nav通过将下一个预定的3D UAV位置投影到目前的2D图像平面来构建其本地目标,将本地视觉监督与下一个动作的预期执行结果联系起来.

blocks.en: 3 ProtoVis-Nav
blocks.zh: 3 Proto Vis-Nav公司

blocks.en: 3.1 Overall Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.1 总体管道

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 1 , ProtoVis-Nav uses Qwen3VL-2B-Instruct Bai et al. (2025) as the VLM backbone. The input consists of dual-view RGB observations (front-view and down-view images), the language instruction, and the current UAV state, including the previous displacement and current position. The Qwen3VL backbone is kept frozen, while the LoRA adapters inserted into the backbone and the newly added output heads are trained.
blocks.zh: 如图一所示,ProtoVis-Nav使用Qune3VL-2B-指令 Bai等 (2025)作为VLM骨干. 输入内容包括双视RGB观测(前视和下视图像),语言指令,以及当前无人驾驶航空器状态,包括之前的迁移和当前位置. Quen3VL主干线被保持被冻结,而LORA适配器被插入到主干线和新添加的输出头被训练.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overall pipeline of ProtoVis-Nav.
blocks.zh: 图1:ProtoVis-Nav的整个管道。

blocks.en: We adopt three types of special query tokens to the model input: <stop> , <pvi> , and <wp> . The <stop> token predicts whether the UAV should terminate the current navigation episode. The <pvi> tokens are short for Prototypical Visual Imagination (PVI), which produce visual prototypes that capture the local visual features around the next intended UAV location. These PVI tokens are then used as context for waypoint prediction. The hidden state of the <wp> token is used by the waypoint head to predict a waypoint for short-horizon trajectory generation.
blocks.zh: 我们在模型输入中采用三种类型的特殊查询符:"stop","pvi"和"wp". <stop>令牌预测无人机是否应当终止当前导航插曲. <pvi>令牌为"原生视觉想象"(PVI)所简称,它产生视觉原型,能捕捉到下一个预定无人机位置周围的局部视觉特征. 随后这些PVI符被作为路由预测的上下文. <wp>令牌的隐藏状态被中标头用来预测短视轨迹生成的出站点.

blocks.en: Specifically, the hidden state of <stop> is passed through a linear layer and a sigmoid activation to produce a stop probability p stop p_{\mathrm{stop}} . When p stop p_{\mathrm{stop}} exceeds a predefined threshold τ stop \tau_{\mathrm{stop}} , the model issues a stop signal. Details of stop-head supervision are provided in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh: 具体地说,"停止"的隐藏状态通过线性地层和sigmoid活化来产生停止概率p stop p_{\mathrm{stop}}. 当p stop p_{\ mathrm{stop} 超过预定义的阈值\ tau_{\ mathrm{stop} 时, 模型会发出停止信号 。 截头监督的详细情况见附录A.1。

blocks.en: For visual imagination, the K K <pvi> tokens predict the feature prototypes, which are combined through a softmax-normalized linear weighting to produce an outcome-associated local visual representation of the target local region. This encourages the model to anticipate what the relevant visual context should look like before predicting the next action. See Section 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 对于视觉想象来说,K K <pvi> 符号预测了特征原型,这些原型通过软正态线性加权结合,产生目标地區与结果相關的地方视觉表现. 这鼓励模型在预测下一步行动之前,先预测相关视觉背景应该是什么样子. 见第3.3节。

blocks.en:
Finally, the <wp> token considers the <pvi> tokens as context within the VLM, and the waypoint head combines its hidden state with UAV kinematic information to predict the next waypoint.
Details of the waypoint head are in the Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh:
最后,"wp"令牌将"pvi"令牌视为VLM范围内的上下文,而路标头将其所隐藏的状态与UAV动能信息结合起来来预测下一条路标.
指针头的细节见附录A.2。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Benchmarks and platform. We conduct experiments on OpenUAV and the obstacle-aware region traversal tasks in HUGE-Bench. OpenUAV is built on the TRAVEL platform Wang et al. (2024a) . It provides diverse outdoor environments, realistic flight dynamics, and closed-loop simulation support for continuous UAV navigation. The platform supports physics-based UAV control with 6-DoF pose representation and configurable sensors such as RGB/depth cameras. The OpenUAV benchmark contains human-operated UAV trajectories paired with multi-view RGB-D observations, language instructions, UAV states, and waypoint annotations. OpenUAV evaluation uses the L1 assistant setting. HUGE-Bench combines 3D Gaussian Splatting with mesh geometry to support photorealistic rendering and collision-aware evaluation of UAV tasks Guo et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 基准和平台。 我们在HUGE-Bench进行OpenUAV和障碍感区域穿梭任务的实验. OpenUAV建于TRAVEL平台Wang等 (2024a). 它提供多样的室外环境,现实的飞行动态,以及闭路模拟支持持续的无人机导航. 该平台支持基于物理学的无人驾驶航空器控制,并配有6-DoF外观能代表并可配置RGB/深度相机等传感器. OpenUAV基准包含由人类操作的UAV轨迹与多视图的RGB-D观测对等,语言指令,UAV状态,以及出道点说明. OpenUAV评价使用L1助手设置. HUGE-Bench将3D高斯平板与网格几何结合,支持对无人机任务Guo等(2026年)进行光现实化渲染和碰撞感知评价.

blocks.en:
Data split. We follow the official data split of OpenUAV. The training set contains 9,152 trajectories. For evaluation, we report results on the Test Seen and Test Unseen splits.
The Test Seen split contains 1,410 trajectories from objects and scenes seen in the training set. The Test Unseen split contains 1,587 trajectories from maps or objects that do not appear in the training set. Following the official OpenUAV setting, test episodes are further grouped into Full, Easy, and Hard subsets according to trajectory length. Specifically, trajectories shorter than 250 meters are labeled as Easy, while trajectories at or above 250 meters are labeled as Hard. Unless otherwise specified, we report results on the Full subset for variant studies and report Full, Easy, and Hard results for state-of-the-art comparison.
For HUGE-Bench, we use the obstacle-aware region traversal task subset Guo et al. (2026) , which requires traversing a designated area while avoiding obstacles.
We train and evaluate models separately within each benchmark.
blocks.zh:
数据分出. 我们跟随OpenUAV的官方数据分割. 训练集包含有9,152个出行道. 为了评价,我们报告测试结果的“目测”和“测试不明”的“分解”。
试想所分出的内容包含1,410道从训练所所看到的物体和场景所取出. Test Unseen分出包含1,587个出自地图或物体而未出现在训练集中的轨迹. 在OpenUAV正式设置后,测试片段根据轨迹长度被进一步分组为Full,Easy,和Hard子集. 具体来说,短于250米的轨迹被贴上"Easy"的标签,而位于或超过250米的轨迹被贴上"Hard"的标签. 除非另有说明,否则我们报告关于变异研究的完整子集的结果,并报告完整、简单和难得的结果,以便进行最新水平的比较。
对HUGE-Bench来说,我们使用障碍感区域转录任务子集Guo等人(2026年),这需要在避免障碍的同时转录指定区域.
我们在每个基准内分别培训和评价模型。

blocks.en:
Evaluation metrics. We evaluate OpenUAV navigation performance using four metrics: Navigation Error (NE), Success Rate (SR), Oracle Success Rate (OSR), and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) Wang et al. (2024a) .
NE measures the distance between the UAV’s final position and the target position, and is reported in meters; a lower NE indicates that the UAV stops closer to the target.
SR measures the percentage of episodes in which the UAV successfully stops within a predefined distance threshold from the target, and is reported as a percentage.
Following the official OpenUAV setting, an episode is regarded as successful if the UAV stops within 20 meters of the target.
OSR measures whether the UAV reaches the target region at any time during navigation, regardless of whether it finally stops there, and is reported as a percentage.
SPL jointly considers navigation success and path efficiency by weighting successful episodes according to the ratio between the shortest and the executed path length, and is also reported as a percentage.
For NE, lower is better; for SR, OSR, and SPL, higher is better.
For HUGE-Bench, higher normalized Dynamic Time Warping (nDTW) indicates closer alignment with the expert trajectory. Higher Collision-aware Success weighted by Path Length (CSPL) scores and a lower Collision Rate (CR) indicate better performance.
blocks.zh:
评价尺度。 我们对OpenUAV导航性能的评价使用四个公尺:导航出错(NE),成功率(SR),甲骨文成功率(OSR),以及成功被路径长度(SPL)Wang等(2024a)加权.
NE测量了无人驾驶飞行器最终位置与目标位置之间的距离,并以米为单位报告;更低的NE表示无人驾驶飞行器停止靠近目标.
SR测量无人驾驶航空器在预定距离目标阈值范围内成功停止的事故百分比,并以百分比报告.
跟随官员 OpenUAV设置,如果无人机在目标20米以内停止,则一集被视为成功.
OSR测量无人驾驶飞行器在导航期间是否在任何时间到达目标区域,无论它是否最终停留在那里,并以百分比报告.
SPL通过根据最短与已执行路径长度之比对成功事件进行加权,共同考虑导航成功和路径效率,并报告为百分比.
对NE来说,下调更好;对SR,OSR和SPL来说,上调更好.
对HUGE-Bench来说,更高的常态动态时间摇摆(nDTW)表明与专家轨迹的更趋一致. 较高的碰撞-认识成功按路径长度(CSPL)分数加权,较低的碰撞率(CR)表示性能更好.

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare ProtoVis-Nav with representative UAV VLN baselines on OpenUAV, including Random Action, CMA Anderson et al. (2018) , TravelUAV Wang et al. (2024a) , NavFoM Zhang et al. (2025a) , and LongFly Jiang et al. (2025) . Random Action serves as a simple lower-bound policy. CMA is a classical cross-modal attention baseline. TravelUAV is the original VLM-based method on the OpenUAV benchmark. NavFoM is a navigation foundation model evaluated on OpenUAV, and LongFly is a recent spatiotemporal context modeling method for long-horizon UAV VLN. We also report Base (Ours), which uses the same VLM backbone, LoRA setting, stop head, and waypoint head as ProtoVis-Nav, but removes the <pvi> tokens and the PVI Head. On HUGE-Bench, we compare ProtoVis-Nav with Base.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们把Proto Vis-Nav与OpenUAV上的具有代表性的VLN基准进行比较,包括随机行动、CMA Anderson等人(2018年)、TravelUAV。 王等 (2024a), NavFoM 张等 (2025a),又作长飞江等 (2025). 随机行动是一项简单的低限政策。 CMA是典型的跨模式关注基线. 旅费 UAV是OpenUAV基准上基于VLM的原始方法. NavFoM是OpenUAV上评价的导航地基模型,而LongFly是近代长相UAV VLN上下文模型方法. 我们还报告基地(Ours),该基地使用与Proto Vis-Nav相同的VLM主干线,LORA设置,停止头和路标头,但去掉"pvi"符号和PVI头. 在HUGE-Bench上,我们比较了Proto Vis-Nav和Base.

blocks.en: Implementation details. ProtoVis-Nav adopts Qwen3VL-2B-Instruct Bai et al. (2025) as the VLM backbone. During training, we freeze the backbone parameters and train only the LoRA adapters and the newly added output heads. ProtoVis-Nav takes 256 × 256 256\times 256 front-view and down-view RGB images, the language instruction, and UAV state information as input on OpenUAV. HUGE-Bench uses front-view RGB images. The UAV pose and waypoint annotations are used during training to construct the projected target-region supervision for Prototypical Visual Imagination. By default, we use K = 16 K=16 <pvi> tokens and a 32 × 32 32\times 32 target crop. The Prototypical Visual Imagination Head uses a softmax-normalized mixing matrix to combine PVI token hidden states into a target-region visual representation for feature supervision. We train ProtoVis-Nav using AdamW with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} and a global batch size of 64. During evaluation, the maximum number of waypoint steps is set to 200. Training is conducted on 4 NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPUs, and inference is performed on a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU.
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 Proto Vis-Nav 采用 Qune3VL-2B 指令 Bai等 (2025)作为VLM骨干. 在培训期间,我们冻结了主干参数,只培训LORA适配器和新添加的输出头. 原型 Vis-Nav取出256×256 256\times 256前视和下视的 RGB 图像,语言指令,和无人机状态信息作为OpenUAV的输入. HUGE-Bench使用前视RGB图像. 在培训期间,采用了无人驾驶飞行器姿势和路标说明,以构建原生视觉想象的预计目标区域监督。 默认情况下,我们使用 K = 16 K = 16 <pvi> 令牌和 32 × 32 32\tims 32目标作物. 原型视觉想象头使用软马克斯-常态混合矩阵,将PVI信使隐藏状态合并为目标区域视觉表现来进行特征监督. 我们使用 AdamW 来训练Proto Vis-Nav , 学习率为 5× 10 − 5 5\times 10× 5 } 全球批量规模为 64. 在评价期间,将出入口步骤的最大数量设定为200个. 对4个NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU进行了培训,对1个NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU进行了推论.

Results on OpenUAV Test Seen. On the Test Seen split, ProtoVis-Nav obtains strong results across the Full, Easy, and Hard subsets.
For the Full subset, ProtoVis-Nav achieves an NE of 51.77 51.77 m, an SR of 50.78 % 50.78\% , an OSR of 66.50 % 66.50\% , and an SPL of 44.68 % 44.68\% , outperforming all compared methods on the four metrics.

blocks.en:
Compared with Base (Ours), ProtoVis-Nav brings consistent gains on the Full subset, reducing NE from 55.67 55.67 m to 51.77 51.77 m and improving SR from 46.47 % 46.47\% to 50.78 % 50.78\% .

Results on OpenUAV Test Unseen. On the Test Unseen split, ProtoVis-Nav achieves competitive generalization performance.
For the Full subset, ProtoVis-Nav obtains an NE of 90.85 90.85 m, an SR of 30.12 % 30.12\% , an OSR of 41.52 % 41.52\% , and an SPL of 27.53 % 27.53\% .

On the Easy subset, ProtoVis-Nav achieves an NE of 75.43 75.43 m, an SR of 29.22 % 29.22\% , an OSR of 38.44 % 38.44\% , and an SPL of 26.06 % 26.06\% , obtaining the best SR and SPL.

在Easy子集上,ProtoVis-Nav实现75.43 75.43米的NE,29.22%的SR 29.22\%,38.44 % 38.44\%和26.06%的SPL,获得最好的SR和SPL.

Compared with Base (Ours), ProtoVis-Nav improves the Full-set SR from 27.91 % 27.91\% to 30.12 % 30.12\% and reduces NE from 98.04 98.04 m to 90.85 90.85 m.

blocks.en: Results on HUGE-Bench Obstacle-Aware Region Traversal Tasks. Compared with Base, ProtoVis-Nav increases nDTW from 0.1599 0.1599 to 0.1762 0.1762 , SR from 36.39 % 36.39\% to 47.47 % 47.47\% , and CSPL from 0.3179 0.3179 to 0.4161 0.4161 , and reduces CR from 54.46 % 54.46\% to 39.76 % 39.76\% . blocks.en: On OpenUAV, CR measures the percentage of episodes with a collision. Near-collision rate measures the percentage of frames whose obstacle clearance falls below a given threshold, and mean obstacle clearance measures the average distance to the nearest obstacle. We use clearance thresholds of 0.5 0.5 m, 1.0 1.0 m, and 1.5 1.5 m to assess obstacle proximity at different distances.
blocks.zh: 在OpenUAV上,CR测量相撞事件的百分比. 接近障碍率衡量障碍清除低于某一阈值的帧百分比,指障碍清除率衡量距离最接近的障碍的平均距离。 我们使用0.5米、1.0至1.0米和1.5至1.5米的排雷阈值来评估不同距离上的障碍相近程度。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , ProtoVis-Nav reduces CR from 36.44 % 36.44\% to 34.41 % 34.41\% and increases mean obstacle clearance from 16.7205 16.7205 m to 16.8192 16.8192 m. These reductions indicate less frequent exposure to nearby obstacles during flight.

blocks.en: 4.4 Variant Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 变式研究

blocks.en: We conduct variant studies on the Test Seen split to analyze three design choices of ProtoVis-Nav: the visual imagination target, the PVI head design, and the number of <pvi> tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们对"试想之分"进行变体研究,分析Proto Vis-Nav的三个设计选择:视觉想象目标,PVI头设计,和"pvi"符号的数量.

blocks.en:
Visual imagination target. We first evaluate different choices of the visual imagination target. Front view only always extracts the target-region feature from the current front-view image, without adaptive selection between front and down views. Center crop uses the image center as the crop location, instead of projecting the next intended UAV location onto the current image plane. Future full frame uses the visual feature of the full future observation, while Future center crop uses the center crop of the future observation.
As shown in Table 5 , ProtoVis-Nav achieves the best overall performance.
Compared with Center crop , ProtoVis-Nav reduces NE from 69.06 69.06 m to 51.77 51.77 m, showing that the projected target region is more informative than a fixed image-center target.
Compared with Future full frame and Future center crop , ProtoVis-Nav also performs better, suggesting that focusing on the localized region around the next intended UAV location offers a more direct supervision target for aligning visual context with waypoint prediction.
blocks.zh:
视觉想象目标。 我们首先评估视觉想象目标的不同选择。 前视只总是从当前前视图像中取出目标区域特征,而不在前视和下视之间进行适应性选择. 中心收成使用图像中心作为收成位置,而不是将下一个预定的无人机位置投射到当前图像平面上. 未来全帧利用了未来完全观测的视觉特征,而未来中心作物则利用了未来观测的中心作物.
如表5所示,Proto Vis-Nav取得了最佳的总体业绩。
与中心作物相比, Vis-Nav将NE从69.06 69.06米减少到51.77 51.77米,表明预测的目标区域比固定的图像中心目标更能提供信息.
Proto Vis-Nav也表现较好, 认为关注下一个预定无人驾驶航空器地点周围的局部区域,

blocks.en:
PVI head design. We then study the design of the visual imagination head.
The MLP variant directly regresses the target-region feature with an MLP, while ProtoVis-Nav predicts feature prototypes and linearly combines them to estimate the target feature.
As shown in Table 5 , ProtoVis-Nav outperforms the MLP variant across all metrics.
This suggests that the goal of visual imagination is not merely to fit the target feature with a high-capacity output head.
Instead, it is more important to force the <pvi> tokens to encode visual cues that are useful for waypoint prediction.
By forming the prediction as a linear combination of <pvi> tokens, the prototype-based design makes the imagination objective act more directly on the token representations used by the <wp> token.
blocks.zh:
PVI头部设计. 然后研究视觉想象头的设计.
MLP变体会用一个MLP来直接递回目标区域特征,而ProtoVis-Nav则会预测地貌原型并线性地结合它们来估计目标特征.
如表5所示,ProtoVis-Nav在所有指标中都超过了MLP变体。
这表明视觉想象的目标不仅仅是将目标特征与高容量输出头相匹配.
相反,更为重要的是迫使"pvi"符号编码出对路标预测有用的视觉提示.
通过将预测形成为"pvi"符号的线性组合,以原型为基础的设计使得想象客观更直接地在"wp"符号所使用的符号表示上行动.

blocks.en:
Number of <pvi> tokens. We analyze the effect of the number of PVI tokens.
The value of K K controls the number of visual prototypes for representing the imagined target-region feature.
We compare K = { 4 , 8 , 16 , 32 } K=\{4,8,16,32\} to study how prototype capacity affects navigation performance.
As shown in Fig. 5 , the best overall performance is achieved at K = 16 K=16 .
When K K is too small, the PVI tokens may not provide enough capacity to represent the target-region visual feature.
When K K becomes too large, the target-region information may be scattered across redundant PVI tokens, making the context less compact for the <wp> token and weakening its connection to waypoint prediction.
Therefore, we use K = 16 K=16 as the default setting.
blocks.zh:
<pvi> 令牌数 。 我们分析PVI信使数量的影响.
KK的值控制了代表所想象的目标-区域特征的视觉原型的数量.
我们比较K = { 4, 8, 16, 32}K = 4, 8, 16, 32 * 研究原型能力如何影响导航性能.
如图5所示,总体业绩最佳的是K=16K=16。
当KK太小时,PVI符可能无法提供足够的能力来代表目标区域视觉特征.
当 K K 变得过大时,目标区域信息可能分散在冗余的 PVI 令牌上,使得上下文对"wp"令牌不太紧凑并会削弱其与路标预测的联系.
因此,我们使用K=16 K=16作为默认设置.

blocks.zh: 4.5 PVI 空间可视化和Waypoint Token 注意

blocks.zh: 图6 PVI 关注地图在目前图像上的可视化. 红框标出地面真实预测的目标区域,青色标出PVI关注高峰.

blocks.en: Spatial visualization. We visualize two examples by overlaying the PVI attention map on the current image (Fig. 7 ). The cruise and landing examples connect the intended next UAV movement to local visual regions in the front and down views, respectively. In both cases, the attention peak lies within or near the projected target region. This suggests that PVI focuses on visual regions relevant to the next intended UAV movement.
blocks.zh: 空间可视化. 我们通过覆盖当前图像上的PVI关注图(图7)来视觉两个例子. 巡航和起降实例将预定的下个无人机运动分别连接到前视和下视的局部视觉区域. 在这两种情况下,注意力都集中在预计目标区域之内或附近。 这表明PVI侧重于与下一个设想的无人驾驶航空器运动相关的视觉区域.

blocks.en: Waypoint token attention. We analyze the waypoint token’s causal attention over 1,000 frames (Fig. 7 ). We average the attention matrices across frames to summarize interactions between image, PVI, and waypoint tokens. Its attention concentrates on the PVI tokens. The waypoint token can combine this movement-related visual context with the instruction and UAV state through causal attention. Together, the visualizations and analysis suggest that PVI identifies locally action-relevant visual evidence and influences the waypoint token’s representation through attention.
blocks.zh: 标点符号注意。 我们分析1000多帧(图7)的指向符的因果关系。 我们平均跨框架的注意矩阵来总结图像、PVI和指针之间的相互作用。 它的注意力集中在PVI标志上. 道点符可以将这种与运动相关的视觉上下文与指令和无人机状态通过因果关系结合. 这些可视化和分析表明,PVI识别出当地与行动有关的可视性证据,并通过注意影响路标的表示。

blocks.en: 4.6 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.6 定性分析

blocks.en: Figure 8: Qualitative example of ProtoVis-Nav on OpenUAV. The UAV follows the instruction and gradually approaches the target region. The green check mark indicates successful navigation.
blocks.zh: 图8:OpenUAV上的Proto Vis-Nav的定性实例. 无人驾驶航空器遵循指示,并逐步接近目标区域。 绿色检查标记表示导航成功.

blocks.en:
We provide qualitative examples to illustrate how ProtoVis-Nav navigates toward the target.
As shown in Fig. 8 , the instruction describes a white truck parked on an empty street surrounded by multi-story stone buildings.
In this example, the UAV gradually moves along the street, adjusts its viewpoint across consecutive observations, and finally stops near the target truck.
The sequential observations show that ProtoVis-Nav maintains target-relevant visual context for waypoint prediction under changing viewpoints.
This result is consistent with our motivation that prototypical visual features provide useful context for waypoint prediction.
blocks.zh:
我们提供了定性的例子,说明Proto Vis-Nav如何向目标行进。
如图8所示,该指示描述了一辆白色卡车停在被多层石楼所包围的空地上。
在这个例子中,无人驾驶飞行器逐渐沿街行走,通过连续的观测来调整自己的观点,最后停在目标卡车附近.
相继进行的观测表明,Proto Vis-Nav在不断变化的观点下,为路由点预测保持目标相关的视觉上下文.
这一结果符合我们的动机,即原生的视觉特征为路由点预测提供了有用的上下文.

blocks.en: 4.7 Limitations and Social Impact
blocks.zh: 4.7 限制和社会影响

blocks.en:
Despite the improvements, ProtoVis-Nav still faces challenges in complex aerial environments.
Based on our observation, most failure cases are caused by collisions, especially with trees and thin obstacles such as branches, poles, and wires.
These obstacles often occupy only a small image region and may be partially occluded or visually ambiguous. This makes obstacle boundaries and available clearance difficult to estimate from RGB observations.
In future work, we will explore stronger obstacle-aware perception and planning mechanisms, including depth or LiDAR inputs, explicit collision-risk modeling, and anti-collision trajectory refinement for safer UAV navigation.
Our closed-loop evaluation is conducted in simulation. Future work will extend validation to real-world UAV flights and hardware-in-the-loop experiments to assess closed-loop navigation performance under physical sensing and control conditions.
blocks.zh:
尽管情况有所改善,Proto Vis-Nav在复杂的空中环境中仍然面临挑战。
根据我们的观察,大多数故障病例都是由相撞引起的,尤其是与树相撞和树枝,杆子等细小障碍物相撞,并有铁丝网.
这些障碍往往只占据很小的图像区域,可能部分被占据或视觉模糊. 这使得障碍界限和可用的清除难以从RGB观测中估算出.
在未来的工作中,我们将探索更强的障碍感知和规划机制,包括深度或LiDAR输入,明确的相撞风险模型,为更安全的无人驾驶航空器导航而改进反碰撞轨迹。
我们的闭路评估是在模拟中进行的。 今后的工作将扩大到真实世界的无人驾驶航空器飞行和 " 即时 " 硬件实验,以评估在物理遥感和控制条件下的闭舱导航性能。

blocks.en:
ProtoVis-Nav may benefit applications such as search-and-rescue, disaster response, and infrastructure inspection by improving UAV navigation from language instructions.
At the same time, UAV navigation systems may raise safety, privacy, and security concerns if deployed without sufficient safeguards, and should therefore be used with human oversight and deployment constraints.
blocks.zh:
ProtoVis-Nav可通过从语言指令中改进无人驾驶航空器导航,使搜索和救援、救灾和基础设施检查等应用受益。
与此同时,无人驾驶飞行器导航系统如果在没有充分保障的情况下部署,可能会引起安全、隐私和安全方面的关切,因此,在使用这些系统时应受到人力监督和部署方面的限制。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We propose ProtoVis-Nav, a Prototypical Visual Imagination framework for UAV vision-language navigation.
The key idea is to ground waypoint prediction in local visual context associated with the next intended movement, which is especially important for UAVs where small 3D motion errors may lead to unsafe navigation behavior.
ProtoVis-Nav imagines an outcome-associated local visual representation for the intended next UAV movement.
Specifically, it predicts feature prototypes and linearly combines them to estimate the target-region visual feature, and the prototype token representations provide context for waypoint prediction.
This design promotes better alignment between visual context and waypoint outputs.
Extensive experiments on OpenUAV and HUGE-Bench demonstrate the effectiveness of ProtoVis-Nav.
blocks.zh:
我们提出Proto Vis-Nav,这是无人机视觉语言导航的原生视觉想象框架。
关键的想法是在与下个预定运动相关的局部视觉上下文中为路由点预测打出地基,这对于无人驾驶航空器尤其重要,因为小型3D运动出错可能导致不安全的导航行为.
Proto Vis-Nav设想为预定的下一场无人机运动提供与结果相联的当地视觉表现.
具体地说,它预测了地物原型并线性地结合它们来估计目标-区域视觉地物,而原型符号表示为路由点预测提供了上下文.
这种设计促进了视觉上下文与路口输出之间的更好协调.
关于OpenUAV和HUGE-Bench的广泛实验证明了Proto Vis-Nav的有效性.

blocks.en: Following TravelUAV [ 12 ] , we use the same trajectory completion module to convert a coarse waypoint into a short local trajectory, as illustrated in Fig. 9 . In the dataset, each coarse waypoint is associated with a short trajectory segment. Specifically, one waypoint corresponds to 5 local trajectory steps used for execution. Therefore, after the waypoint head predicts a coarse waypoint, we use the trajectory completion module to convert this single waypoint into a short local trajectory. During training, the module is supervised to predict 7 local trajectory points for a richer short-horizon signal, while during execution we only use the first 5 predicted points to control the UAV.

blocks.en: We evaluate spatial consistency on 1,000 Test Seen and 1,000 Test Unseen frames from OpenUAV, each at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution. blocks.en: Appendix C PVI Feature Similarity and Retrieval
blocks.zh: 附录C 特性相似性和检索性

blocks.en: We evaluate the same 1,000 Seen and 1,000 Unseen frames used in Table 4 . Each 256 × 256 256\times 256 frame is densely sampled into 841 candidate patches of size 32 × 32 32\times 32 with a stride of 8 pixels.
blocks.zh: 我们评价表4使用的同样1 000个目镜和1 000个目镜。 每个256×256相256相256相框被密集地取出为841相框的候选补丁,尺寸为32×32相框32相,并有8像素的阶梯.

blocks.en: First, we measure the direct cosine similarity between the predicted PVI representation and the ground-truth target-patch feature, using a randomly selected patch as the baseline. Second, we rank all candidate patches by cosine similarity and report the first-relevant rank. A candidate is considered relevant if its center is less than 32 pixels from the ground-truth target center, within one visual-token width. We report spatial Recall@1, Recall@5, and Recall@10 under the same criterion.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们用随机选择的补丁作为基线,测量预测的PVI代表值与地真目标平面特征之间的直接同位素相似性。 其次,我们通过同位素相似性对所有候选人进行排名,并报告第一相关级别。 如果候选人的中枢从地面-真实目标中心不到32像素,在一个可视相干宽度范围内,则被视为具有相关性。 我们在同一标准下报告空间召回@1、召回@5和召回@10。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 6 , the PVI–target cosine similarity reaches 0.8440 0.8440 on Seen and 0.8449 0.8449 on Unseen, compared with 0.7666 0.7666 and 0.7535 0.7535 for random patches. Among 841 candidate patches, the mean first-relevant rank is 11.19 11.19 on Seen and 15.56 15.56 on Unseen. At the 32-pixel threshold, Recall@1/5/10 reaches 27.00 % 27.00\% / 63.50 % 63.50\% / 80.40 % 80.40\% on Seen and 21.10 % 21.10\% / 54.90 % 54.90\% / 69.30 % 69.30\% on Unseen. These results show that the PVI representation contains information about the ground-truth target patch.

blocks.en: Appendix D Robustness to Observation and Execution Perturbations
blocks.zh: 附录D 观察和执行的力度

blocks.en: We evaluate ProtoVis-Nav on OpenUAV Test Seen under three perturbations. Camera image noise affects the visual inputs, pose estimation noise affects the position and yaw estimates supplied to the model, and execution mismatch introduces action execution errors and horizontal drift.
blocks.zh: 我们在OpenUAV上评估Proto Vis-Nav 试所见入于三焦下. 相机影像噪声会影响视觉输入,使估计噪声会影响提供给模型的位置和yaw估计,执行错配会引入动作执行错误和水平漂移.

blocks.en: Appendix E Evaluation on UAV-Flow
blocks.zh: 附录E 对无人驾驶飞行器花序的评价

blocks.en: We compare ProtoVis-Nav with Base on UAV-Flow [ 17 ] . Normalized Dynamic Time Warping (nDTW) measures trajectory alignment. We use double-blind human annotation to determine the success rate based on manual inspection of whether the trajectory semantically satisfies the instruction, consistent with official UAV-Flow settings.
blocks.zh: 我们把Proto Vis-Nav和UAV-Flow上的基地进行比较 [17]. 常态化 Dynamic Time Warping (nDTW) 测量轨迹对齐. 我们使用双盲人注解,根据手动检查轨迹是否符合指令,与官方的无人驾驶飞行器-飞行设置一致来确定成功率.

blocks.en: Table 8: Closed-loop results on UAV-Flow.
blocks.zh: 表8:无人驾驶飞行器-飞行器闭路结果。

blocks.en: On the full test split of UAV-Flow, ProtoVis-Nav improves closed-loop nDTW from 0.2971 0.2971 to 0.3104 0.3104 and SR from 67.77 % 67.77\% to 72.16 % 72.16\% over Base (Table 8 ), indicating closer alignment with the reference trajectories and higher task success. UAV-Flow evaluates fine-grained flight skills, so these gains suggest that target-region visual features also provide useful context for short-range motion control.
blocks.zh: 在UAV-Flow的全测试分出上,ProtoVis-Nav改进了闭合-loop nDTW,从0.2971 0.2971到0.3104,SR从67.77 % 67.77%到72.16%,比起Base(表8),表明与参考轨迹更加一致,任务成功率更高. UAV-Flow评价了精细的飞行技巧,因此这些收获表明目标区域视觉特征也为短程运动控制提供了有用的上下文.

blocks.en: Appendix F Backbone Comparison
blocks.zh: 附录F 后骨 比较

blocks.en: We compare Qwen3-VL and Wan2.1-VACE in a controlled backbone-transfer experiment on OpenUAV Test Seen, using the same PVI design, waypoint heads, action representation, training data, and evaluation protocol. Inference latency is measured for a single forward pass on the same GPU.
blocks.zh: 我们在OpenUAV Test Seen上的受控主干传输实验中比较了Qune3-VL和Wan2.1-VACE,使用相同的PVI设计,取道口头,动作代表,培训数据,以及评价协议. 对同一GPU上的单个前传进行推论延迟度测量.

blocks.en: Table 9: Navigation performance and inference latency of different backbones on OpenUAV Test Seen.
blocks.zh: 表9:OpenUAV测试 Seen上不同干线的导航性能和推论性能.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 9 , Qwen3-VL increases SR from 17.25 % 17.25\% to 50.78 % 50.78\% and SPL from 14.79 % 14.79\% to 44.68 % 44.68\% , while reducing latency from 333.83 333.83 ms to 185.48 185.48 ms. World action models (WAMs) offer explicit physical foresight for longer-horizon planning, with diffusion-based generation incurring iterative inference costs. ProtoVis-Nav trades this multi-step foresight for efficient local waypoint prediction, conditioning the next waypoint on an outcome-associated local visual representation in a single forward pass.
blocks.zh: 如表9所示,Qune3-VL将SR从17.25% 17.25%增加到50.78% 50.78%,SPL从14.79% 14.79%增加到44.68% 44.68%,同时将休息时间从333.83 333.83毫秒减少到185.48 18.548毫秒。 世界行动模型(WAMS)为较长期的规划提供了明确的物理展望,其以传播为基础的生成会产生迭接推论成本。 原型 Vis-Nav用这种多步骤的展望来进行高效率的局部路由点预测,将下一个路由点建立在单一前进通道中与结果相关的局部视觉表现上。

blocks.en: Appendix G Effect of inference-time PVI interventions
blocks.zh: 推断时间发言的效果

blocks.en: We further examine the contribution of PVI context through inference-time interventions. We evaluate four PVI intervention settings on Test Seen Full. Intact uses the PVI representations predicted for the current sample; Shuffled exchanges these representations across samples; Masked blocks PVI information from reaching the waypoint predictor; and Random replaces it with random features. As shown in Table 10 , Intact achieves the highest SR, OSR, and SPL and the lowest NE across these settings. Shuffling reduces SR from 50.78 % 50.78\% to 41.09 % 41.09\% , while masking and random replacement further reduce it to 37.87 % 37.87\% and 36.75 % 36.75\% , respectively. These results show that the waypoint predictor uses sample-specific PVI information during inference, with coherent local visual context contributing to successful navigation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过推论时间干预,进一步审查免疫倡议的贡献。 我们评价四个PVI 干预设置 测试全。 Intact使用当前样本预测的PVI表示; Shuffled在样本之间交换这些表示; Masked块 PVI 信息从到达路口预测器;和 Random 替换为随机特性. 如表10所示,Intact在这些设置中实现了最高的SR,OSSR和SPL以及最低的NE. shuffling将SR从50.78 % 50.78\%降至41.09% 41.09\%;而口罩和随机替换则进一步分别降至37.87% 37.87\%和36.75% 36.75\%. 这些结果显示,路由点预测器在推论期间使用特定样本的PVI信息,而连贯的局部视觉环境有助于导航的成功.
